notes: Generic cue filenames remain fixed for the shared runtime contract. The four collection cues are musically distinct for each title. Music and reel textures have exact-zero 2ms boundaries, circular mixing and reverb; nonloops have 4ms edge fades. Vorbis encoding and PCM decode verification run for every cue. Runtime synthesis is unnecessary. Excluded existing titles: Midnight Vault (dragon-hoard), Wukong, Pirates and the separately supplied Gold Foundry palette. Arcane Archives uses MintoDog's CC0 Magic Puzzle In-Game 1 for continuous base and bonus music. Gods of Olympus uses Viktor Kraus’s CC BY 3.0 Secret Sanctum for base music. Neon Nights selects a CC0 NICE callout for paid wins and the supplied drum and synth bass loop for Special Plays.

suites.title: Neon Nights
suites.theme: User-approved original Neon Nights composition; exact existing WAV masters preserved.
suites.provenance: The twenty original Neon tracks retain their unchanged user-approved original synthesized PCM masters. The additional win-nice-v1 callout uses Sadiquecat’s original human recording “Joyful - Nice 2,” released under CC0, with local EQ, compression and slap delay. Source and license are documented beside this manifest. No commercial game audio is sampled. Special Plays music uses the user-supplied LEX WAV loop.
